in_greek.name: Ελευθεριά
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Eleutheria' meaning 'freedom'. The name Livvie does not have a direct Greek equivalent, but it could be interpreted as a modern adaptation of the Greek name 'Eleutheria' due to its meaning of freedom and the similarity of the first three letters.

in_latin.name: Livia
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Vivus' meaning 'alive'. The name Livvie does not have a direct Latin equivalent, but it could be interpreted as a modern adaptation of the Latin name 'Livia', which shares the same root as 'Livvie'.
